description: Act on a data-ai-id element. type appends at caret, setContent replaces all. page_changed:false = dispatched but page unchanged (wrapper).

action.description: Verb. Verb-specific params live in the group of the same name.

keep_tab.description: Stay on this tab instead of following a newly opened one.

opened_tab_wait_ms.description: Extra wait ms for a site-opened tab (default 250 on link targets; pass it to force, 0 off).

url.description: Hit the link whose href matches this URL (for composite cards with several links).

drag.description: drag only. from/to = points, dx/dy = relative, target_to = drop onto an element.

button.description: Canvas apps pan on middle/right drag.

file.description: upload: absolute path. target may be the input, the trigger, or a CSS selector.

html.description: paste: HTML, preferred (keeps headings/bold). landed_chars:null = unreadable.

press.description: press only. Keys go to the current focus, so target is optional.

key.description: Delete, Escape, ArrowRight, Enter, or a combo like "Meta+a".

read.description: get_value only — read-only: does not focus the element or fire input events.

limit.description: Max code points to return (default 20000, hard cap 1000000).

offset.description: Start offset in Unicode code points (default 0).

target.description: data-ai-id from the tree (e.g. e:button-12) — NOT the visible label. Optional for press; drag may use drag.from; upload also takes a CSS selector.

text.description: type: appended at the caret. setContent: replaces all. paste: plain fallback when html is absent.

timeout_ms.description: Deadline ms (default 15000, 1s..300s). On timeout: success=false, timed_out=true, may have partially applied.

wheel.description: wheel only. Lands on target, or the viewport centre when target is omitted.

dy.description: Vertical delta. Negative scrolls up / zooms out.

hold.description: Modifiers held, e.g. ["Control"] to zoom a canvas.

name: browse_act
title: Act on element
